description: Add a domain such as acme.com, in a pod if you name one (a platform’s customer). Answers the TXT record a person publishes at the domain’s DNS host to prove it (nothing is changed there), then verify_domain. Needs the Everything level; a key of one pod adds to its own pod only.

pod_id.description: The pod it goes in; left out, the default pod.

name: add_domain
title: Add a domain
